commits.messageBody:
Keep the existing Win32 naked assembly and public types unchanged. The x64 path uses the 16/32-bit CRT byte swaps, without importing Winsock or widening protocol values.

Identical client TU passed native v120 Debug/Release on Win32/x64: 166631 input cases per run, both directions, including every ushort. Stock Win32 passed the same oracle; stock x64 failed compilation; identity-swap controls failed. This is leaf-function evidence, not a full x64 build.
commits.messageHeadline: foundation: implement Windows x64 byte order with byteswap functions
